component.name: Win's VPN
component.summary: Privacy-focused VPN with free and premium access

description.p: Win's VPN provides a privacy-focused VPN client for users who need reliable access on hostile or unstable networks.

Winn Protocol v3 is the primary tunnel protocol. Winn v1 over AWG then Xray remains available only when the trusted served configuration selects that cover path. A failed Winn v3 security check is a connection refusal, not an implicit fallback.
The app supports free access where available, premium account activation, legal acceptance, server selection, referral sharing, and platform-native tunnel control.
Premium access opens the official Win's VPN website purchase section. Payment processing is handled by the external payment provider shown at checkout.
The Privacy Policy is at https://www.winsvpn.org/privacy/. Support is at https://www.winsvpn.org/support/.

Linux x86_64 and arm64 release 1.0.17+34 (AppStream 1.0.17, Debian 1.0.17-34). The Win's VPN browser companion can now pair with the desktop app: the app shows a pairing code, you confirm it in the extension, and the paired extension can connect and disconnect the VPN. Winn v3 remains the primary datapath.

Linux x86_64 and arm64 release 1.0.16+33 (AppStream 1.0.16, Debian 1.0.16-33). Winn v3 (Winn Protocol v3) is the primary datapath. AWG then Xray remains the ordered cover path only when the trusted served configuration selects it. A failed Winn v3 security check is a connection refusal, not an implicit fallback. AppImage is not a current upload target.
Cross-platform release with dynamic AmneziaWG and Xray failover, truthful launcher-scoped split tunneling, hardened leak protection, and current shared VPN UI fixes.
